baseline: all six original EEG relative-band features
bootstrap: 4000 stratified participant-cluster bootstraps preserving five repeats
held_out_unit: participant, not a two-second epoch or a minute
interpretation: complementary predictive contribution, not causal biomarker importance
model: StandardScaler + balanced RBF SVC, 3-fold train-only nested hyperparameter search
multiplicity: Holm adjustment across eight first-minute group-removal contrasts
outer_folds: Five repeats of five participant-stratified folds, identical to prior thesis
permutation: 10000 paired participant-level sign flips; approximate post-hoc inference
reference_audit: full-model predictions and raw decision scores must reproduce saved results
test: all five held-out 60s blocks; first-minute BACC is main endpoint
training: only first-minute training-participant features; no held-out participant samples
